description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of ten channel pairs, all but the first followed by an SBR payload (the second with an SBR header): the first block decides, so the stream stays AAC LC at 22050 Hz, and most blocks disagree.
findings: 9 of 10 raw data blocks hold SBR data after a channel element
but 9 of 10 raw data blocks hold SBR data; the first block that disagrees is raw data block 2

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.decode: ffmpeg prints "No quantized data read for sbr_dequant" for the SBR payloads after the first block.
